benchmark_model_inference_fps: run the benchmark tool to measure inference FPS of an MMSeg segmentation model using a config and checkpoint
benchmark_model_with_repeat_times: run the benchmark tool with --repeat-times to average FPS across multiple evaluation runs
benchmark_model_custom_work_dir: run the benchmark tool with --work-dir to save FPS results JSON to a custom output directory
benchmark_model_custom_log_interval: run the benchmark tool with --log-interval to adjust how often FPS progress is printed during benchmarking
review_benchmark_main: review the main function that builds the dataloader, loads the model checkpoint, and measures inference FPS over 200 iterations
